{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Uniting behind a program that restores faith in democratic government, re-institutes progressive taxation, defends and extends public goods and social insurance, restores and expands labor rights, and builds just global institutions can curb the power of corporate elites.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Corporate globalization has exacerbated inequality.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The corporate domination of U.S. politics and society has undermined ordinary people’s living standards most egregiously over the last thirty years.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The corporate domination of U.S. politics and society has most perniciously undermined the living standards of those already beaten down.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democratizing the distribution of power in the United States can restore the promise of the American Dream to those who have seen it taken away.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democratizing the distribution of power in the United States can extend the promise of the American Dream to those previously excluded from full membership in society.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Toward an Economic Justice Agenda is a perspectives piece intended to lead to a consensual legislative and political program.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"A broad coalition of progressive groups can coalesce around a consensual legislative and political program.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The document was revised with input from DSA members and nonmembers.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The document was revised with input from other organizations that make up the broad progressive community.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The document was revised with input from organizations engaged in similar discussions.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The DSA formally adopted an official version of the document at its national convention in November 2007.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
